name: Crucible of the Spirit Dragon
description: A blasted region of Tarkir where the spirit dragons were called, now home to floating hedrons and a gathering dragonstorm.

timeline.summary: The performers conjure a diorama of the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon and narrate the discovery of the Stormnexus Ritual; Narset recalls the desperate gamble.
timeline.quote: It'd been a gamble; they had no idea what the ritual would do.

pages_say.description: The place where Narset and the rebellion leaders cast the Stormnexus Ritual.
A blasted region of Tarkir where the spirit dragons were called, now home to floating hedrons and a gathering dragonstorm.
The place where a voice told Narset and Elspeth to seek a temple in the dragonstorms.
